payload.reason: The evidence provides specific datasets used for evaluation in different tasks, including image captioning and translation.

claims.text: The evaluation for the image captioning task was conducted on the Microsoft COCO 2014 dataset, which contains 123,287 images.
For the translation task, the tst2012 dataset was used for validation and tst2013 for testing, with the IWSLT 2014 dataset for De-En.
The IWSLT 2014 dataset for De-En contains 160K sentence pairs for training and around 7K sentences for testing.
The evaluation for WMT14 En-De used case-sensitive tokenized BLEU score, while IWSLT 2015 En-Vi and IWSLT 2014 De-En used case-insensitive BLEU.
